    TOGGLE: TRUE

### Please try to


- divvy up tables/sections of the room between tutors in the lab, and concentrate on your area. 
    - feel free to move around and help in other tutors' sections if theirs has lots of questions and yours is quiet! 
    
- make sure every table gets at least a cheery "hello" from one tutor each session
    - better yet, follow this up with asking how they're getting on! 
    
- ask each other/tutor coordinators to help out with explanations if you're getting stuck

- make sure tables don't get ignored (even if no hands are going up)
    - if all is quiet, try **actively** asking a table 1) where they're up to in the exercises, 2) if they need any help etc. 


### Please avoid

- standing around using phone/device
- standing around chatting with one another
- sitting down at a table on your own
